title: Saga Pattern
subtitle: Replace one big transaction with local steps and an undo for each, and make the undos safe to retry
motto: If you cannot roll back, roll forward with an apology
keyInsight: A saga keeps a multi-service operation consistent by undoing completed steps when one fails, but the undos can fail too, so they must be idempotent and retried.

decisions.title: Fail the undo, not just the step
decisions.description: The failure frame makes some compensations fail, because the weak point of a saga is the rollback that is itself a network call.
decisions.alternatives: Showing compensations always working would present a saga as a transaction.

decisions.title: Count messages for both styles
decisions.description: The last frame states the message count for orchestration and for choreography, so the choice is priced in traffic and in visibility of state.
decisions.alternatives: Naming the two styles without numbers would not show that choreography sends fewer messages but hides the saga's progress.
